note: Scripture register follows Louis Segond (1910), the register the shipped French corpus uses. The English edition's epigraphs are loose children's paraphrases introduced with “— from <Book> <chapter>”, rendered here “— d’après <Livre> <chapitre>” (with “le Psaume” for psalms); they carry no verse number, so the verse-consistency audit's (Book C:V) pairs never see them.

The verse numbers above are English numbering (Psalm 68:6 is Segond 68:7). Only 1 Thessalonians 5:18 (“Rendez grâces en toutes choses.”) is a verbatim substring of a shipped French file. Every other epigraph is a plain, child-register rendering of the English paraphrase, kept close to Segond's vocabulary (e.g. “l’abri du Très-Haut”, “fidèle dans les moindres choses” simplified to “les toutes petites choses”), so it is self_rendered. Genesis 5:24 is the inline “marchait avec Dieu” (Segond: “marcha”), tense adapted to the sentence. api.takeroot.bible was not used.
Translated in-session. No quotations from Corrie ten Boom's published writings were added; the English paraphrases her accounts and so does this edition.
